style.prompt: Vertical event poster, warm cozy illustrated night market with food stalls, steaming dishes, lanterns and glowing string lights across a dark blue evening sky. Clean bold readable typography in a clear area at the top and bottom. Large title text exactly: "Night Market". Below it, exact text lines: "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard", "Free entry". All text spelled exactly, crisp and legible, high contrast cream lettering. Warm orange and gold palette, flat illustration style.

reason: insufficient credits: this call needs about 10 credits and 0 remain on the account

why: The reply says it could not make the poster or reel because the Magic Hour account has 0 credits and the first step was refused. It states nothing was made or charged. It asks for no information or approval and does not present a result. It is blocked by the account's credit limit, so it fits "cannot".
text:
I couldn't make the poster or the reel. Your Magic Hour account has 0 credits left, and the account turned down the first step.

- The poster needs about 10 credits. I tried qwen-image-2.1, a free-plan model, at 9:16 and 640px.
- The reel would cost more credits on top of that. It would use the free ltx-2.5 model at 480p with sound off.
- Nothing was charged and nothing was made.

Here's the plan once you have credits again:
1. Make the vertical poster with all five lines: "Night Market", "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard", "Free entry". It will show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights.
2. Animate that same poster into an 8-second silent 9:16 reel. Only the lights and the stall scene will move, so the text stays still and readable.

One thing to know: AI video can sometimes blur or bend text. If that happens, I'll tell you and suggest a fix.

Your credits may refill on the free plan, or you can add credits to your account. Tell me when you have credits and I'll start.
